title: Writer Technology Infinite Canvas Lsp
description: Create a new writer technology: full-blown text editor on infinite canvas (Vello/WebGPU via infinite/cavas), real JSON-RPC LSP client/server in Web Worker, writer playground with jack fixture, jack language server (lint/format/hover/completion), integrate WriterCanvas into trinity/jack shell replacing CodeEditor.
summary: Added puzzle-style writer context menu via ContextMenuController: right-click moves caret and shows editor actions with Suggest completions when LSP has items; Alt+right-click opens the completion list directly. Menu includes pick disambiguation, selection, rename, clipboard, format, and lint. Completions popup is gated by completionsOpen; left-click pick menu unchanged.
